notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
